GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well. Pushed fwd & worked to race 2nd 3 Wide No Cover (1L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to hold ground @ 350m. Pushed along Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened from 250m & eased down late. # Worked & weakened.
Bit Slow Out sat last 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4l off, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out whilst under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down 2nd last 6 Lengths 600m 8th 6 Lengths home turn 8th rails took inside run Straight Kept Going Ok # back/rails/ok late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was directed in near the 300m to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off 3 Wide No Cover , under pressure turn and dropped out # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover from the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Touch slow away. Recovered & raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead) early . Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & held together Two Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pushed to quicken @ 300m & hit lead Four Wide @ 250m. Held them well in last 200m. # Had perfect run.

Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 450m. Pushed along 3 Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & held ground in last 200m. # Even effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 150m, commenced to lay out under pressure and had to be corrected to avoid heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began fairly. Not pushed early & raced keenly behind Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Held Ground until pushed out Five Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Seven Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 300m & held ground in last 200m. # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Near the 800m was checked when tightened between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: COT: Ridden further fwd. Away evenly. Rolled fwd & raced behind leader Two Wide (2L from lead) early . Tracked leader Two Wide midrace & 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pushed to quicken @ 250m & pressured @ 200m. Challenged leaders @ 150m but shaded late. # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics: intention to be ridden further forward; settled off-pace. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Near the 500m, when continuing to race keenly, was steadied when awkwardly placed to the heels of another runner. Raced greenly under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (3L from lead). Back 1 length & out Two Wide midrace until pushed out 3 Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & held ground Two Wide in last 200m. # Fair effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that his mount commenced to hang out near the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward Outside Equal Lead . Hard Ridden Same into str, Battled On Well til Beaten 150m and Weakened . vet = nil # =led/weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
